acceptance_criteria: X-BPM-Signature header present in dispatched webhook for secret-configured subscription
description: TC-EXT-02-INT-05 (Signature header is present only for secret-configured subscription and matches body HMAC) fails: signed_receiver.signature_seen is false after calling dispatchDueWebhookAttempts. The HMAC X-BPM-Signature header is not being added to the webhook dispatch HTTP request for secret-configured subscriptions. This is a functional defect in the dispatcher signature logic, not related to the ISS-0118 status value assertion fix.
title: TC-EXT-02-INT-05: HMAC webhook signature header not seen during dispatch
